allowlist.ac_lhw_eru_services: Worst case only: the Lighthouse War status paragraph plus a settled policy in all nine Erusean registers. Before any policy is chosen it is 8 lines.
allowlist.ac_fe_eru_services: Worst case only: the Free Erusea war status paragraph plus a settled policy in every Erusean register. Before any policy is chosen it is 10 lines.

allowlist.ac_snp_yuk_programmes: The measured worst case prints all 16 scope lines at once; at most two national offices can be active, so play reaches far fewer. Idle scopes print nothing.
